result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots show only the first viewport. That covers the color section in both answers and the start of typography in B. Neither shows the type and spacing scales, the usage rules or the sample form, card and status message, so items 1 and 3-5 are scored mostly on intent. B organizes color by job, with background, surface, text, muted text, primary, primary hover, status and border, and it names the CSS variables that components use. A presents a hue palette (Brand 900/700/100, Ink 900/700) with hex codes and only partial role labels, and it has no background or surface roles. Both look calm and suit a clinic, and both use system fonts. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots show only the top of each page, so the form, card, status message and usage rules can't be checked, and their scores are partial guesses. A organizes color by job, with named tokens for background, surface, text, muted text, primary, its hover and subtle states, success/warning/danger/info and border. B mostly lists a teal brand scale and hex codes, only some swatches name their job, and it has no page background or surface token. Both have a calm clinical tone, but A's role-based naming is the stronger foundation from what is visible.
